verdict.rationale: ChatGPT documents scheduled and event-triggered automations. It also lets you review active, paused, and completed tasks and their recent runs in the Scheduled view, which covers only the 'review' part of the story. Nothing in the evidence shows automation definitions being versioned or rolled back. Missing for 10: version history for automations, rollback to a prior automation version, diff/review of automation changes, independent corroboration.
